lyrics.ja: ゆっくり走れ！走れ！
lyrics.en: Run slowly! Run!

lyrics.ja: 道に迷った時がチャンスだ
lyrics.romaji: Michi ni Mayotta Toki ga Chansu Da
lyrics.en: When you lose your way, that's your chance

lyrics.ja: 目の前のことにがむしゃらで
lyrics.romaji: Me no Mae no Koto ni Gamushara de
lyrics.en: Recklessly focused on what's in front of you

lyrics.ja: 間違いは数え切れなくて
lyrics.en: Countless mistakes
lyrics.zh: 犯下的錯誤數也數不清

lyrics.ja: 一つのことに手一杯で
lyrics.romaji: Hitotsu no Koto ni Teippai de
lyrics.en: Overwhelmed with just one thing
lyrics.zh: 光是一件事就忙不過來

lyrics.ja: ただ前しか見えてなくて
lyrics.en: Unable to see anything but what's ahead

lyrics.ja: 「まっすぐ進もう」
lyrics.en: "Let's go straight ahead"

lyrics.ja: キラキラした言葉の持つ
lyrics.en: The power held by sparkling words

lyrics.ja: 「止まらずに行こう」
lyrics.en: "Let's go without stopping"

lyrics.ja: 力に押されそうだ
lyrics.en: I feel like I'm about to be overwhelmed by their force
lyrics.zh: 彷彿快被這股力量壓垮

lyrics.ja: 忘れたくないよ
lyrics.en: I don't want to forget

lyrics.ja: ただ『好き』の気持ち
lyrics.en: Just this feeling of "love"

lyrics.ja: 他人の興味ばかりを気にするのはやめよう
lyrics.romaji: Tanin no Kyoumi Bakari wo Ki ni Suru no ha Yameyou
lyrics.en: Let's stop worrying so much about other people's interests
lyrics.zh: 別再只在意他人的眼光了

lyrics.ja: ゆっくり走れ！走れ！
lyrics.en: Run slowly! Run!

lyrics.ja: 道に迷った時がチャンスだ
lyrics.romaji: Michi ni Mayotta Toki ga Chansu Da
lyrics.en: When you lose your way, that's your chance

lyrics.ja: 『何にもない』もない
lyrics.en: There's no such thing as "nothing at all"

lyrics.ja: 新しい僕が見つかるはずさ
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii Boku ga Mitsukaru Hazu sa
lyrics.en: I'm sure you'll find a new you
lyrics.zh: 一定能找到嶄新的自己

lyrics.ja: 出来ないことばっかり見えて
lyrics.en: All you can see are the things you can't do

lyrics.ja: くるくるいつも遠回り
lyrics.en: Always going around in circles, taking the long way

lyrics.ja: だけど昨日よりは道が見える
lyrics.romaji: Dakedo Kinou yori ha Michi ga Mieru
lyrics.en: But you can see the path better than yesterday
lyrics.zh: 但比昨天更能看清道路

lyrics.ja: なら大丈夫
lyrics.en: If so, it's okay

lyrics.ja: 踏み出してしまった道は
lyrics.en: Once you've stepped onto a path

lyrics.ja: なかなか戻りづらくなって
lyrics.en: It becomes hard to turn back

lyrics.ja: これも一つの経験だ
lyrics.romaji: Kore mo Hitotsu no Keiken Da
lyrics.en: This too is one experience

lyrics.ja: たった一人の人生だ
lyrics.en: It's a life lived by just one person

lyrics.ja: 『わからないこと』がわからないと言い出せない
lyrics.en: I can't bring myself to say I don't understand what I don't understand
lyrics.zh: 無法說出自己不懂那些不明白的事

lyrics.ja: 臆病な僕をみんなは責めなかった
lyrics.romaji: Okubyou na Boku wo Minna ha Semenakatta
lyrics.en: No one blamed me for being a coward
lyrics.zh: 大家都沒有責備膽小的我

lyrics.ja: 忘れたくないよ
lyrics.en: I don't want to forget

lyrics.ja: この『僕』の気持ち
lyrics.en: This feeling of "me"

lyrics.ja: 『誰か』を演じてた
lyrics.en: I was playing the role of "someone"

lyrics.ja: 嘘はもうやめよう
lyrics.en: Let's stop the lies already
